notes.title: Just FIVE days till RELEASE!
notes.notes:
Hey PPL! 
How is it going?
It's been a long way for us, the way of given up on Gamedev and goin back in.
But now we're finally on the path to our first release on Steam.
We're are a team of two brothers living the dream of indie game development! Let's gooo!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790867/aa8e887cb2b7df022678bc998061ab6c32bb258e.gif

We're hoping you'll enjoy this small adventure full of monsters, boss fights and rewards!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790867/b37d74d88b7430d603aaceeaa33cd9cc664e1338.png

Have fun! ;)

Boss Crab Games Team
